api.note: OrangeHRM's public demo instance does not expose a stable, unauthenticated REST API for PIM employee records. Per the assessment's own fallback instruction, ReqRes is used to SIMULATE the API validation step (create/update/delete/get user) while the UI steps run against the real OrangeHRM employee record. Field-level values captured from the UI (employeeId, jobTitle, employmentStatus) are sent to / compared against the simulated API payload so the cross-check logic and assertions are real, even though the backing service is a stand-in. See README 'API Validation Strategy' for details and how to swap in a real OrangeHRM API/service.
